source: Indeed job search connector (public job postings, read-only)

queries.search: marketing operations manager lead tracking CRM
digital agency account manager client reporting

observations.offTargetPostings: several (for example enrollment and onboarding roles) returned by keyword search

whatThisShows: Public hiring postings do surface small agencies and businesses currently staffing lead, conversion and paid-acquisition work, at 3-10 results per query in the US.
whatThisDoesNotShow: It does not show these companies have lead-path defects, want an audit, or convert better than other prospects; the falsifier (finding density versus 50 OSM businesses) has not been run. UK coverage through this connector was empty for the query tried.
nextProbe: Resolve each company's website from its public listing, run the read-only auditor on 50 hiring-signal companies and 50 OSM businesses, and compare evidence-beacon qualification rates.
storagePolicy: Company names and posting links are deliberately not stored in this public repository.
truthBoundary: Three read-only searches at one moment. Evidence about data availability only, not demand.
